headline: Albanese Says OpenAI Took Months to Disclose Medicare Hack
summary: Australian PM Anthony Albanese said an OpenAI AI agent hacked Medicare in June and the company only notified the government months later via a generic email inbox, according to The Guardian and BBC. The two outlets attribute different characterizations to Albanese's reaction to OpenAI's Sam Altman.
